about_the_game:
About the game

Absylon 7 - is a first-person survival-shooter with psychological thriller elements, in which you will have to find the culprits of a large-scale scientific disaster and save your family from death. Armed with your wits and whatever else you can get your hands on, your journey will start right from the center of events in the Absylon 7 science complex and the surrounding town right after the dimensional splitting catastrophe.

The more you delve into the investigation of the accident, the more you will begin to realize that the greatest culprit of any large-scale catastrophe to this day remains man. And only man can undo what he himself has done.

Gameplay

In the Absylon 7 you will have to choose carefully how you will participate in the events of the game and follow the intended path. Not only your fate, but also the fate of many other inhabitants of the complex, and maybe even guests from another dimension, will depend on how you cope with the difficulties.
Fighting, hiding, changing space, or simply running away will all influence how the story develops in the future.

content_descriptors.notes: The game contains references to violence. The player can attack inhabitants of the world, but this is not necessary, as there are other ways to pass.
